## Review: FAFF-7001

### Phase 1: standard review (faffter-noon-review)

Signal: pass. No findings.

## Adversarial findings

---

UNAVAILABLE (mandatory second opinion not obtained)

The run ledger marks adversarial review as mandatory. The only configured backend, openai/fixture-model, returned HTTP 429 (fixture rate limit). The helper classed this as an all-rate-limited exhaustion (12) and remapped it to 9 because review is mandatory. No opinion was obtained, and the build must park before a PR is opened.

### critical: Mandatory adversarial review chain outage

Location: .faffrc.yaml
Every backend in the `adversarial.code_review` chain was rate-limited, so the mandatory second opinion is missing.
Action: Add a fallback backend that is not rate-limited to .faffrc.yaml, or wait for the rate limit to clear, then re-run the review.
